capabilities: Answer questions grounded in notes, Bases and CSV files with citations
Propose note creation, rewrite, move, rename and delete as diffs for approval
Compute counts, aggregations, date arithmetic and link audits with deterministic tools
Run vault-stored skills and workflows and call tools from companion plugins and MCP servers
disambiguation: Not a grammar or verb tool; it is an AI agent that reads and edits documents in your vault.
extras: Desktop only; interface and agent follow Obsidian's language (Korean or English). Optional Windows x64 offline pack adds local embeddings; otherwise the PGlite runtime and tokenizer table are downloaded on demand. No telemetry. Skill files are compatible with Claude Code skills.
intentEvidence: Verbex began as a fork of Smart Composer (MIT, Heesu Suh) and was redeveloped from there.
problem: Getting AI help on a vault usually means copying notes into a chat, and letting a model edit files risks changes you cannot review or undo.

relations.evidence: Verbex began as a fork of Smart Composer (MIT, Heesu Suh) and was redeveloped from there.
Companion plugins expose their tools to the agent after you approve them
HWP Hands exposes only reading tools by default

requires.name: Model provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio or OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
Companion plugins (Chart Hands, KorDoc Transform, HWP Hands, HWPX Exporter)

summary: AI agent that answers from vault notes, Bases and CSVs and proposes file edits as diffs applied only after approval.
